lyrics.ja: 超電波ピース！巡ってまるごとガブッ！と
lyrics.romaji: Chou Denpa Piisu! Megutte Marugoto Gabu! to
lyrics.en: Super radio wave peace! It circles around and takes a big bite!
lyrics.zh: 超電波Peace！環繞著一口全咬下！

lyrics.ja: 宇宙(そら)の彼方へ　テストで交信 Chu！
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Kanata e Tesuto de Koushin Chu!
lyrics.en: To the far reaches of space—test transmission, chu!
lyrics.zh: 向宇宙彼方，測試通訊 Chu！

lyrics.ja: サイン波で唸らせてる
lyrics.romaji: Sainha de Unaraseru
lyrics.en: Making it roar with sine waves
lyrics.zh: 以正弦波發出低鳴

lyrics.ja: 胸躍る超(スーパー)銀河の音
lyrics.romaji: Mune Odoru Suupaa Ginga no Oto
lyrics.en: The sound of a super galaxy that makes my heart leap
lyrics.zh: 令人心動的超級銀河之聲

lyrics.ja: (アバンチューるラリーラリー)
lyrics.romaji: (Abanchuuru Rarii Rarii)
lyrics.en: (Adventure, rally, rally)
lyrics.zh: （冒險，拉力拉力）

lyrics.ja: 8光年先の未来誰もが求めるウェルネス
lyrics.romaji: Hachi Kounen Saki no Mirai Dare mo ga Motomeru Werunesu
lyrics.en: A wellness everyone seeks in a future eight light-years away
lyrics.zh: 八光年外的未來，人人都追求的安康

lyrics.ja: (8次元まで)飛んじゃって
lyrics.romaji: (Hachi Jigen made) Tonjatte
lyrics.en: Flying off (to the eighth dimension)
lyrics.zh: （直到八次元）飛了過去

lyrics.ja: 地球上そうテクテクテクノロジー
lyrics.romaji: Chikyuu Jou Sou Tekuteku Tekunorojii
lyrics.en: On Earth, technology just keeps on stepping along
lyrics.zh: 地球上的科技一步步前進

lyrics.ja: 満たされちゃってる
lyrics.romaji: Mitasarechatteru
lyrics.en: We're already so fulfilled
lyrics.zh: 已經被滿足了呢

lyrics.ja: (アバンチュール PANICPANIC)
lyrics.romaji: (Abanchuuru PANIC PANIC)
lyrics.en: (Adventure—panic, panic)
lyrics.zh: （冒險，恐慌恐慌）

lyrics.ja: あっちゅーまに時代はぐるり廻り宇宙は8周目？
lyrics.romaji: Atchuuma ni Jidai ha Gururi Mawari Uchuu ha Hachi Shuume?
lyrics.en: In the blink of an eye, the era spins around—is the universe on its eighth lap?
lyrics.zh: 轉眼間時代轉了一圈，宇宙是第八圈？

lyrics.ja: さぁ時代創造して　さぁ次の波へ
lyrics.romaji: Saa Jidai Souzou Shite Saa Tsugi no Nami e
lyrics.en: Now, create the era—now, to the next wave
lyrics.zh: 來吧，創造時代，來吧，前往下一波浪潮

lyrics.ja: さぁ無限大の可能性へ乗って
lyrics.romaji: Saa Mugendai no Kanousei e Notte
lyrics.en: Now, ride toward infinite possibilities
lyrics.zh: 來吧，乘上無限大的可能性

lyrics.ja: 超電波ピース！　ジャックしてまるごとガブッ！と
lyrics.romaji: Chou Denpa Piisu! Jakku Shite Marugoto Gabu! to
lyrics.en: Super radio wave peace! It jacks in and takes a big bite!
lyrics.zh: 超電波Peace！駭入後一口全咬下！

lyrics.ja: 宇宙(そら)の彼方踊れ踊れ
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Kanata Odore Odore
lyrics.en: Dance, dance beyond space
lyrics.zh: 在宇宙彼方起舞吧起舞吧

lyrics.ja: 超電波ピース！　巡ってまるごとガブッ！と
lyrics.romaji: Chou Denpa Piisu! Megutte Marugoto Gabu! to
lyrics.en: Super radio wave peace! It circles around and takes a big bite!
